http_header_truncation_desync.surface: Node.js forwarding proxies that rebuild outbound headers from visible IncomingMessage headers while piping the original request body to a reused backend connection
http_header_truncation_desync.reason: The exact WFM staging runtime is pinned to Node 22.23.2, the Node.js security release containing the official CVE-2026-58044 fix. Retain this rule so a future runtime downgrade or incomplete security-release inventory fails review.
http_header_truncation_desync.external_advisory_note: GitHub's unreviewed GHSA-44cw-v76j-7fvv currently describes the same request-desynchronization condition under CVE-2026-48932. Treat the Node.js project's CVE-2026-58044 security-release record as canonical for WFM runtime version decisions until external databases reconcile identifiers.

containment.reason: Node 22.23.2 bundles undici 6.28.0. Until the pinned Node 22 image contains undici >=6.28.1, WFM server code must not use the bundled WebSocket client or undici retry interceptor. Built-in fetch remains permitted because these tracked September 4 advisories require the affected WebSocket or retry-interceptor surfaces.
containment.upgrade_trigger: Move to an approved digest-pinned Node 22 image only after exact-candidate integrity and regression gates prove process.versions.undici >= 6.28.1.

runtime_dependency_expectation.reason: The exact staged runtime is self-contained and currently imports only Node.js built-ins; introducing a third-party runtime package or package manager requires an explicit security-baseline change and candidate revalidation.

removed_base_image_attack_surface.mitigation: npm/npx/corepack and related package-manager entry points are removed from the final staging runtime because they are not required by the application.
